current.headline: Defensive posture with one clear trim opportunity — reduce INTU overweight, harvest XLK gains, and let oversold positions breathe.

Trim XLK to lock in the only meaningful winner and redeploy selectively into oversold quality names once reversal signals confirm. The $1,000 swing budget stays dry until ABT or INTU deliver a clean technical entry — do not chase in a Fear environment.

Reduce INTU to bring allocation from 34% back below the 25% cap — sell enough shares to right-size the position regardless of P&L; do not wait for a recovery to rebalance a rule violation.

Do not add yet — RSI at 21 and price on lower BB signals extreme oversold, but death cross and sub-200MA structure require a confirmed reversal candle and RSI reclaim above 30 before entry; set alert at RSI 30 crossover.
Hold small profitable position and monitor BB squeeze resolution within 2 weeks — if price breaks upward with volume, target $35.50; if it breaks down, exit immediately per your stop trigger.
Hold and do not add — down 28% post-earnings with BB squeeze unresolved; wait for RSI to confirm buy zone entry or flag further downside before any action; panic-selling here locks in max loss.
Hold with no additions — no confirmed reversal signal yet, RSI not in buy zone, and adding to a losing position without a setup violates your entry rules; reassess in 4-8 weeks.

what_to_watch: INTU earnings print — do not act before it; reassess technicals post-print for a potential re-entry at lower allocation
ABT RSI reclaiming 30 and a confirmed reversal candle above the lower Bollinger Band — this is your next swing entry trigger

history.headline: Defensive posture required — trim overbought XLK to fund oversold re-entries while bleeding positions in INTU and TEM demand triage.
history.overall_thesis: With 64.9% tech concentration, a 5.87% portfolio drawdown, and Fear sentiment at 38, the priority is reducing overweight risk in INTU and locking in XLK gains before momentum fades. The $1,000 swing budget should remain on standby for mean-reversion setups in deeply oversold quality names like ABT once confirmation signals fire. Patience on MSFT, CMG, and TEM — force no new entries until technicals confirm.

priority_actions.instruction: Trim 30-40% of XLK position immediately — RSI at 79.5 is deep overbought, well above your 70-80 sell threshold; lock in +19% gains and reduce tech concentration below the 25% cap pressure point.

Trim INTU to bring it under the 25% portfolio cap — you are overweight a -13.1% loser with no buy signals firing; reduce size now to free capital and limit concentration risk before earnings volatility.

Place ABT on high-priority watchlist — RSI at 23.1 and price near lower Bollinger Band are textbook oversold signals on a quality name; wait for RSI divergence and a volume confirmation candle before adding from swing budget.
Hold CMG at +5.7% — RSI at 34.8 is approaching your buy zone; do not add yet, but do not exit a modest winner; reassess if RSI dips below 30 for a potential add.
Hold MSFT and wait — golden cross setup and MACD inflection are constructive but RSI at 48.9 needs more time; no action until price action confirms mean-reversion momentum over 4-8 weeks.

Hold TEM position but set a hard stop-loss review point — down 28.4% with no confirmation signals firing; if no technical improvement materializes within 4 weeks, prepare a disciplined exit to protect remaining capital.

history.biggest_risk: INTU exceeds the 25% portfolio cap while sitting at -13.1% — a single bad earnings print could cascade into a portfolio-level drawdown that wipes out all remaining gains from XLK and CMG.
what_to_watch: INTU earnings date and pre-earnings RSI/price action for any mean-reversion setup or exit trigger
ABT RSI divergence and volume spike as the signal to deploy swing budget on a quality oversold name
VIX and Fear & Greed Index — if Fear drops below 30 or VIX spikes above 20, shift to full defensive mode and pause all new entries
on_course_check: Plan is working if: XLK trim proceeds at +19%, INTU is reduced below 25% cap, and ABT begins showing RSI divergence above 25 within 2 weeks
Plan needs revision if: INTU breaks to new lows post-earnings, TEM continues declining with no technical base, or VIX spikes above 20 invalidating mean-reversion setups across the board

history.headline: Hold your oversold positions patiently, trim the one winner flashing overbought, and stop the bleeding on TEM before it gets worse.
history.overall_thesis: With 5.87% in the red, a VIX in neutral territory, and Fear & Greed sitting at 38, this is not the time to chase new positions or add risk. The priority is capital preservation and intelligent recovery — trim XLK while it still has juice, let ABT and MSFT mean-revert on their own timelines, and enforce the $44 stop on TEM without emotion. Over the next 4-8 weeks, the goal is to flatten the overall P&L, reduce INTU concentration below 25%, and exit TEM cleanly if the stop is hit.
top_priorities: TRIM XLK immediately — RSI at 79.5 is a clear overbought signal and locking in partial gains from your only strong winner is non-negotiable given the current defensive posture
ENFORCE the $44 stop on TEM — you are down 28% with zero confirmed entry signals; do not let a swing trade become a long-term hold out of hope
MONITOR INTU concentration — at 33% it breaches your 25% cap; do not add to it and be ready to trim into any technical strength post-earnings to rebalance
history.biggest_risk: TEM breaches $44 and you hesitate — a 28% loss that turns into 40%+ is the single fastest way to derail recovery across the entire portfolio.
what_to_watch: TEM price vs. $44 stop level — check daily, no exceptions, no rationalizing a hold below that line
XLK RSI normalization — watch for RSI to pull back toward 60-65 as a signal that the trim was well-timed and the position is stabilizing
ABT RSI and Bollinger Band position — RSI at 23.1 is deeply oversold; a bounce toward RSI 35-40 with price moving off the lower band is your confirmation that the mean-reversion thesis is activating
on_course_check: Plan is working if: XLK trim is executed within 2 weeks, TEM is closed at or above $44 if stop is triggered, and total portfolio drawdown stops widening beyond -6%

Plan needs revision if: ABT continues falling with no RSI recovery after 3 weeks, MSFT golden cross fails to materialize and price breaks below its current base, or overall P&L drawdown accelerates past -8%
